evidence.quote: Our opening term sheet is $28 million for the class, distributed automatically, plus $7 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses, subject to court approval.
The parties negotiated the class relief and attorneys’ fees together from the outset.

Hargrove’s latest term sheet provides automatic payments, preserves full judicial review of fees, and has a maximum total outlay of $30.5 million—within authorization and materially below the other counsel’s latest terms.

summary: Hargrove raised fees alongside class relief, and the parties negotiated both before settling either. Hargrove privately considered its own fee economics, while the defense chose its offer in part because it was cheaper than competing counsel’s terms. The transcript does not show a fee-for-class-relief trade, and Hargrove’s declaration accurately describes the negotiation sequence.
